author: Fextralife
description:
Valor Mortis  GAMEPLAY Impressions - I Played It...
In this video, I want to talk about my hands-on impressions with Valor Mortis. This is the second time I've got to play this. I got to play a preview build of this a while back, but this time I got to play a significant chunk of the game. I played about 5 to 6 hours or so, the first 5 or 6 hours of the game.
